'''Darkelf2000 Black Sun Agenda 2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darkelf2000]]
* '''Published:''' 8 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS Darkelf2000 DS 2003 BlackSun 4775.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Revision of my previous Black Sun Deck!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

This is somewhat of an  overhaul of my previous black sun deck that I threw together after viewing others, and playtesting a bit.

Turn 1:  Use Ket to pull C:DB, and to grab greedo (check for Tatooine: Jabba's Palace) use L,L,L to pull T:JP, and that to pull JP:AC.  Deploy Greedo to C:DB (along with another ground fighter or 2), move Xizor over, and flip.

Turn 2:  Use Ket to grab DB94, Greedo to grab Oota(V), and T:JP to grab the dungeon.  Only other site left in deck is the BF:B, and its pullable with WMAOP.

From here, i like to run the deck as a capture/beatdown deck.  Damage comes from Ability Ability Ability, First Strike, your objective, The vast array of weoponary that cause damage, Desilijic Tattoo (again, using your weopons to cause damage) and of course, from drains and potential beatdowns.  Retreival from S&V; and First strike (3 each battle you intiate), and the Dungeon.  Should you lose xizor, thats the sweet thing about JP:AC.  Save its game text to download your backup xizor!!.  As for space, xizor/virago, Guri/stinger, and ZiMH (with 4lom as a passanger, possibly) should be able to put up a good fight.

Activation of 13 on its own, while giving your opponent 4 (less, if you so wish, since you chose what sites you deploy).

Anyways, hope this is an improvement.  I'm really striving to create a very competitive Black Sun deck.  Comments and suggestions appreciated!
